7.name: Velvet Night
7.why: Night wrapped in cloth, dark enough to hold one warm lamp.

7.name: Moonless Hour
7.why: The hour after the last lamp goes out, when the blue is deepest.

7.name: Under Narikala
7.why: The fortress wall at night, where the lamps begin behind the carved balconies.

8.name: Sugar Cube
8.why: A pale, warm white that looks as though it was set down under a lamp.

8.name: Lantern Paper
8.why: The soft glow of a paper lantern before it is lit, nearly neutral and warm.

8.name: Old Plaster
8.why: Tbilisi walls gone pale with age, catching the light behind the balconies.
